node_types.why: A declared engineering task class. Resources declare the concerns they address; the concrete packet task classifies into concerns. Without this node type the only path from work to a resource was a compile-time projection over the Feature record, which is identical for every task performed on that Feature - so the concrete task could never change what was retrievable, which DEC-026 step 2 and the canonical re-resolution tests require.
node_types.canonical_id: the task class literal, e.g. RLS_SECURITY

orphan_policy.type_rule: A node type with zero connected instances has no edge vocabulary; connect it or stop compiling it.
orphan_policy.note: SCREEN/USER_JOURNEY are declared but not yet compiled; CHANGESET, RESEARCH_FINDING and CANON_CHALLENGE are empty in a clean repository by design.
